about: Test vectors for the omo-senpi turn_completed masking, generated by executing the client's maskProviderAndModel; the client and the collector both test against this file byte-identically.
hash_recipe: source.files[path] = sha256 of the file bytes at source.commit (git show <commit>:<path> | shasum -a 256); known_models_sha256 = sha256 of jobs/backfill/known-models.json as committed (shasum -a 256 jobs/backfill/known-models.json)
